## Inventory

### Module list

App layer (top-level `src/molmcp/*.py`)
- `src/molmcp/__init__.py` — package facade / public API aggregator
- `src/molmcp/__main__.py` — `python -m molmcp` shim
- `src/molmcp/cli.py` — argparse CLI (`serve`/`info`/`search`/`explore`/`index`/`registry`)
- `src/molmcp/config.py` — strict `molcrafts.json` loader
- `src/molmcp/runtime.py` — assembles registry + collection from config
- `src/molmcp/server.py` — FastMCP server builder
- `src/molmcp/provider.py` — Provider protocol + entry-point discovery
- `src/molmcp/mcp_provider.py` — `MolCraftsContextProvider` (the 4 core MCP tools)

Domain layer
- `src/molmcp/collection/` — `__init__`, `index.py`, `models.py`
- `src/molmcp/registry/` — `__init__`, `core.py`, `models.py`, `manifest.py`, `entrypoints.py`
- `src/molmcp/introspection/` — RESIDUAL: no `.py` sources; only stale `__pycache__` (`__init__`, `_resolve`, `modules`, `search`, `source` bytecode). Deleted on this branch.

Discovery engine (`src/molmcp/discovery/`)
- Facade/engine layer: `engine.py`, `query.py`, `config.py`
- Pipeline: `extract.py`, `resolve.py`
- Contract: `schema.py`
- Ranking/evidence/lint: `ranking.py`, `evidence.py`, `lint.py`
- `analyzers/` — `__init__`, `base.py`, `_tree_sitter.py`, `python.py`, `typescript.py`, `rust.py`, `cpp.py`, `markdown.py`, `config.py`
- `store/` — `__init__`, `graphstore.py` (+ `schema.sql` package-data)
- `source/` — `__init__`, `resolver.py`, `local.py`, `github.py`, `walk.py`
- `cache/` — `__init__`, `snapshotcache.py`, `extractcache.py`, `freshness.py`, `watch.py`
- `overlay/` — `__init__`, `catalog.py`, `conventions.py`

Leaf layer

- `src/molmcp/helpers/` — `__init__`, `subprocess.py`, `text.py`

- `cli`: `main`.
- `config`: `AppConfig`, `ServerConfig`, `RegistrySourceConfig`, `ConfigurationError`, `load_config`, `CONFIG_SCHEMA_VERSION`, `DEFAULT_CONFIG_NAME` (no `__all__`; module-level).
- `runtime`: `build_registry`, `build_collection`, `config_summary` (no `__all__`).
- `provider`: `Provider` (runtime_checkable Protocol), `discover_providers`, `PROVIDER_ENTRY_POINT_GROUP` (="molmcp.providers"), `PROVIDER_NAME_PATTERN`, `RESERVED_PROVIDER_NAMES` (={"molcrafts"}).
- `mcp_provider`: `MolCraftsContextProvider` (name="molcrafts"; registers `molcrafts_info/search/describe/explore` + 3 resources).

- `registry`: `__all__` = `CAPABILITY_ENTRY_POINT_GROUP`, `MANIFEST_FILENAME`, `SCHEMA_VERSION`, `CatalogItemV1`, `CatalogKind`, `DuplicateJSONKeyError`, `ExecutableCapabilityV1`, `Invocation`, `InvocationKind`, `LoadedManifest`, `ManifestError`, `Provenance`, `Registry`, `RegistryConflictError`, `RegistryError`, `RegistryItemNotFoundError`, `RegistryValidationError`, `Requirements`, `canonical_sha256`, `dumps_manifest`, `load_installed_manifests`, `load_manifest`, `load_manifest_data`, `loads_manifest`, `parse_catalog_item`, `split_registry_id`, `validate_registry_id`.

Entry-point group contracts
- `pyproject.toml` `[project.scripts]`: `molmcp = molmcp.cli:main`.
- `pyproject.toml` `[project.entry-points."molmcp.providers"]`: `molexp = molmcp.providers.molexp:MolexpProvider` — the single declared provider; this is the `molmcp.providers` group external packages register against (const `PROVIDER_ENTRY_POINT_GROUP` in `provider.py`).
- Two further entry-point group contracts are consumed but NOT self-declared in `pyproject.toml` (open extension seams for downstream packages): `molmcp.capabilities` (`CAPABILITY_ENTRY_POINT_GROUP`, consumed by `registry/entrypoints.py:load_installed_manifests`) and `molmcp.overlays` (`OVERLAY_ENTRY_POINT_GROUP`, consumed by `discovery/overlay/__init__.py:load_overlays`).
- `pyproject.toml` `[tool.setuptools.package-data]` ships `molmcp.discovery.store/*.sql` (the `graph.db` schema).

### Style summary

- `config`: naming=`*Config` frozen slotted dataclasses + `from_dict`/`default` classmethod constructors; construction=schema-validated, unknown-field-rejecting (`_reject_unknown`), env-name/URL/digest regex gates; errors=fail-closed `ConfigurationError(ValueError)`, non-loopback HTTP requires `auth_token_env`.
- `runtime`: naming=`build_*` free functions; construction=composes `Registry` + `CollectionIndex` + `DiscoveryEngine`; errors=digest-mismatch/redirect/size `ValueError`, HTTPS-only + no-credential URL enforcement, env-expansion fail-closed.
- `provider`/`server`: naming=`Provider` runtime_checkable Protocol, `create_server` factory; construction=entry-point discovery instantiates zero-arg classes, mounts each provider under `<name>` namespace via child FastMCP; errors=name-pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`, reserved `molcrafts`, duplicate-name `ValueError`; non-explicit provider failures logged+skipped into `runtime_status["failed"]`, explicit ones re-raised.
- `mcp_provider`: naming=`molcrafts_*` tool functions; construction=all tools carry frozen `_READ_ONLY` ToolAnnotations; errors=graceful structured error dicts (`ref_not_found_or_stale`) never exceptions; every response tagged `provenance`/`freshness`.
- `collection`: naming=frozen slotted dataclasses (`SourceBinding`, `SearchHit`, `ContextPack`) with `to_dict()`; construction=`__post_init__` validation + duck-typed engine/registry (RRF fusion, `_RELIABLE_RELATION_PROVENANCE`); errors=`TypeError`/`ValueError` at boundaries; deliberately owns wire types, no discovery `Node` leakage.
- `registry`: naming=`*V1` frozen dataclasses + StrEnum kinds; construction=fail-closed, batch-atomic registration (duplicate ID rejects whole batch, no last-write-wins); manifests content-addressed (`canonical_sha256`); errors=layered `RegistryError`/`RegistryConflictError`/`RegistryItemNotFoundError`/`RegistryValidationError`/`ManifestError`; strict jsonschema + packaging validation; foreign-namespace manifests rejected.
- `discovery.schema`: naming=StrEnum + slotted dataclasses; construction=`node_id()` canonical identity; contract-only, versioned (`SCHEMA_VERSION`/`ANALYZER_VERSION` bumped on breaking change).
- `discovery` engine/pipeline: naming=phase classes `Extractor`/`Resolver`, `DiscoveryEngine`/`DiscoveryQuery`; construction=snapshot-keyed immutable cache, incremental via `ExtractCache`; errors=per-file analyzer errors recorded not raised, unresolved refs kept in `graph.unresolved` (graceful degradation); `AnalyzerNotAvailable` caught and logged.
- `discovery.ranking`/`evidence`/`lint`: naming=pure functions + module-constant weights (`W_*`); construction=stateless over graph/store, field-weighted bm25 recall then reliable-signal re-rank; RESOLVED-only caller counts — guessed edges never influence rank; no SQLite/MCP imports.
- `discovery.analyzers`: naming=`*Analyzer` implementing `LanguageAnalyzer` Protocol; construction=extension-keyed `ANALYZER_REGISTRY`, language-local (no cross-file resolution); errors=`AnalyzerNotAvailable` for stub backends.
- `discovery.store`/`source`/`cache`: naming=`GraphStore`, `Snapshot`/`SnapshotId` frozen slotted, `SnapshotCache`/`ExtractCache`/`FreshnessTracker`; construction=write-once immutable `graph.db` (`create` then read-only), FTS5 with LIKE fallback, slugified cache dirs; errors=`SourceError(RuntimeError)`.
- `discovery.overlay`: naming=`CapabilityOverlay` Protocol + `OverlayContribution` slotted dataclass; construction=TOML-declared catalog/conventions merged post-resolution, discovered via `molmcp.overlays` entry points; errors=one failing overlay logged+skipped, never aborts load; format core / content shipped by domain package.
- `middleware`: naming=`*Middleware` (fastmcp `Middleware`) + `validate_tool_annotations` startup pass; construction=path-key traversal rejection, response byte cap; errors=`ToolError`/`MissingAnnotationsError(RuntimeError)`, fail at build time.
- `helpers`: naming=`run_safe` + `SubprocessResult` frozen dataclass, `fence_untrusted`; construction=list-only `cmd`, mandatory timeout, `shell=True` unreachable, untrusted-content fencing (prompt-injection neutralization).
- `providers.molexp`: naming=`MolexpProvider` (name="molexp") + `materialize_*`/`add_*`/`validate_*` scaffold functions, `LayoutLevel`/`Findings` layout types; construction=lazy `molexp` import inside functions, workspace resolution via arg/`MOLEXP_WORKSPACE`/cwd sentinels; errors=`RuntimeError` on unresolved workspace; contract: navigation/layout read-only, scaffold idempotent create-or-get, never drives run batches or workflow runtime.

### Layer roles

- `cli`, `__main__`, `server`, `runtime`, `config`, `provider`, `mcp_provider` — App layer (entrypoints + composition + FastMCP boundary; only `server`/`provider`/`mcp_provider`/`providers.molexp` import MCP machinery per rule 2).
- `collection`, `registry` — Domain layer (registry + federated retrieval; MCP-free, duck-typed toward MCP).
- `introspection` — Domain layer per historical rules, but RESIDUAL on this branch (no sources; stale bytecode only).
- `discovery/engine.py`, `query.py`, `config.py` — Discovery engine facade layer (rule 3: `engine` is the MCP-free facade).
- `discovery/extract.py`, `resolve.py` — Discovery pipeline layer (phase-1/phase-2 under engine).
- `discovery/schema.py` — Discovery contract layer (language-agnostic; every analyzer emits only this; core-owned).
- `discovery/ranking.py`, `evidence.py`, `lint.py` — Discovery retrieval/analysis layer (pure functions on graph, no store/MCP).
- `discovery/store/`, `source/`, `cache/`, `analyzers/` — Discovery leaf layer (persistence, snapshot resolution, freshness, language seams — below engine per rule 3).
- `discovery/overlay/` — Discovery overlay layer (rule 4: domain content enters via overlays after resolution, never by editing `schema.py`).
- `middleware`, `helpers` — Leaf layer (MCP-free utilities; `helpers` is provider-facing, `middleware` wraps the FastMCP boundary).
- `providers/molexp/` — Provider layer (leaf; MCP-importing plugin, the only live provider, registered via the `molmcp.providers` entry point).
- `providers/` siblings (`molpy`, `molpack`, `molq`, `molrs`, `lammps`, `molexp.py`) — Provider layer per rules, but RESIDUAL on this branch (bytecode only, no sources).
